summary: Clackamas County, OR summit where a tent lookout (1911 or 1914) gave way to an L-4 cab in the 1930s; the cab was gone by about 1949.

facts.design: Ground L-4 cab, built in the 1930s after an early tent lookout
facts.status_note: The L-4 cab was gone around 1949; no source describes a structure left on the summit

access.note: Summit reached on foot from the Baty Butte Trail, per Oregon Hikers; no source describes a lookout to visit

visit.trail_note: A short scramble from the Baty Butte Trail along the south ridge; stay back from the steep southwest face

events.note: Tent lookout set up on the summit (Forest Lookouts; Oregon Hikers). The register and firelookout.com date the first tent to 1914.
First lookout was a tent with a phone placed by the USFS (register); firelookout.com lists '1914: camp.'
Two men in charge of the lookout while they were at Bagby Hot Springs (Molalla Pioneer item, quoted by Forest Lookouts)
L-4 cab gone around 1949 (register); 'Gone 1949' (firelookout.com); decommissioned before 1950 (Oregon Hikers). Method of removal not stated.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts and Oregon Hikers date the first tent lookout to 1911; the register and firelookout.com say 1914. The story gives both and does not pick one.
The register says gone around 1949, firelookout.com says 1949, and Oregon Hikers says the lookout was decommissioned before 1950. These agree within about a year.

notes_for_editor: Four sources, all read. The 1930s L-4 cab has no exact year in any source, so it is in the story but not as a dated event. The record's material 'wood' (material_from design) is not stated by any source we read; left unchanged. Oregon Hikers also lists a 'Baty Butte via Thunder Mountain' route tagged 'Closed'; unclear what that refers to, so not used. No new photos found; the existing FFLOS panorama is the only image in the record.
